name: Moto-Psycho Madness
author: Addicting Games
description:
Moto-Psycho Madness is a free racing game. You like to move fast. We all like to move fast. Does it make you crazy? Does it make you a psycho? Well, it might if you like to move fast on a motorcycle. Moto-psycho madness is a sickness, it is madness spread through the smell of burnt rubber and spent diesel. Choose from four different motorbikes, gear up and roll out. Hit a ramp with your lights flashing and streak through deserts, jungles and city streets alike. The only treatment for moto-psycho madness is two wheels, a humming engine and the streak of smoke from your muffler as you rocket around downtown.

Moto-Psycho Madness is a game but it is not playing. It is a thrill ride that will launch you face-first into the visceral excitement of the high octane world of stunt racing, dirt bikes, high jumps and low levels of self-control. Let your thirst for adventure guide you to explore an open world thrill ride that will let you experience a radical change of pace. You'll blow a gasket in Moto-Psycho Madness: The hot new racing game from the makers of Desert Drift Royale.
